subject: Fix valkey and json module versions in build and integration test. (#363)
reason: The change edits only scripts/common.rc, a build/CI helper script that clones and builds valkey-server and the valkey-json module for valkey-search's own integration tests: it makes VALKEY_VERSION and VALKEY_JSON_VERSION overridable env vars and clones valkey-json by branch instead of a pinned commit. No module source code is touched, so the loaded valkey-search module's commands, replies, indexing, replication or persistence behaviour are identical on both builds; there is no runtime path a scenario could exercise.
